neighbours.label: a playful or exasperated gesture beat in fiction: rolling her eyes, sticking a tongue out, groaning in unison
fire: "Very funny," Mia muttered, rolling her eyes at him.
My little sister stuck her tongue out and ran away.
Ben and I groan loudly as the teacher hands out the quiz.
"Whatever you say," he replied, rolling his eyes.
She pokes her tongue out at me across the table.
The boys all groaned in unison when the coach blew the whistle.
"Oh please," Lena said with a roll of her eyes.
I stick out my tongue at the camera and laugh.
quiet: "Very good," Mia said, closing the door behind him.
My little sister picked up her bag and ran away.
Ben and I sit quietly as the teacher hands out the quiz.

She passes the salt to me across the table.
